content:
Track: SQL Fundamentals for Data Analysts
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to SQL and Relational Databases
    - Lesson 2: Basic SQL SELECT Statements
    - Lesson 3: Filtering Rows with WHERE Clause
    - Lesson 4: Sorting Results with ORDER BY Clause
    - Lesson 5: Combining Tables with JOIN Operations
    - Lesson 6: Writing Complex Queries using AND, OR, and NOT operators
    - Lesson 7: Aggregating Data with SQL Functions (SUM, AVG, MAX, MIN)
    - Lesson 8: Grouping Data with GROUP BY Clause
    - Lesson 9: Handling NULL Values in SQL Queries
    - Lesson 10: Advanced Query Optimization Techniques

   Track: Python for Data Analytics (Beginner)
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Python and Jupyter Notebook
    - Lesson 2: Data Structures: Lists, Tuples, and Dictionaries
    - Lesson 3: Control Flow: Conditional Statements (IF, ELSE)
    - Lesson 4: Loops and Iterations (For, While)
    - Lesson 5: Functions in Python
    - Lesson 6: Working with CSV files using Pandas Library
    - Lesson 7: Data Cleaning Techniques in Pandas
    - Lesson 8: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) with Pandas and Matplotlib
    - Lesson 9: Introduction to Libraries: NumPy, Scipy, Statsmodels
    - Lesson 10: Intermediate Data Manipulation Techniques in Pandas

   Track: Data Cleaning and Preprocessing (Advanced)
    - Lesson 1: Handling Missing Values in Datasets
    - Lesson 2: Outlier Detection and Removal Strategies
    - Lesson 3: Text Preprocessing for Text Data
    - Lesson 4: One-Hot Encoding and LabelEncoding Techniques
    - Lesson 5: Handling Imbalanced Datasets
    - Lesson 6: Feature Engineering Techniques
    - Lesson 7: Dimensionality Reduction Techniques (PCA, t-SNE)
    - Lesson 8: Data Normalization and Scaling Techniques
    - Lesson 9: Handling Categorical Variables using Encoders
    - Lesson 10: Best Practices for Data Preprocessing and Cleaning

   Track: Intermediate Python for Data Analytics
    - Lesson 1: Advanced Pandas Techniques (Merging, GroupBy with Agg)
    - Lesson 2: Working with Databases using SQLite3 or PyODBC
    - Lesson 3: Time Series Analysis and Forecasting (Pandas Timedeltas)
    - Lesson 4: Regression Models in Scikit-learn Library
    - Lesson 5: Classification Models in Scikit-learn Library
    - Lesson 6: Clustering Algorithms in Scikit-learn Library
    - Lesson 7: Ensemble Methods (Random Forest, Gradient Boosting)
    - Lesson 8: Evaluating Model Performance (Metrics, Cross-Validation)
    - Lesson 9: Machine Learning Pipelines and Workflows with Scikit-learn
    - Lesson 10: Introduction to Deep Learning with TensorFlow or PyTorch

   Track: Data Visualization with Python (Intermediate)
    - Lesson 1: Advanced Matplotlib Plot Styling and Customization
    - Lesson 2: Building Dashboards using Seaborn Library
    - Lesson 3: Interactive Plots with Bokeh and Plotly Libraries
    - Lesson 4: Creating Animations in Python for Time-Series Data
    - Lesson 5: Map Visualizations for Geospatial Data
    - Lesson 6: Building Dashboards for Real-Time Streaming Data
    - Lesson 7: Designing Effective and Accessible Data Visualizations
    - Lesson 8: Sharing and Presenting Your Work with Python Notebooks
    - Lesson 9: Creating Custom Plotting Libraries (Optional)
    - Lesson 10: Best Practices for Data Visualization and Storytelling

   Track: Business Intelligence with Tableau
    - Lesson 1: Introduction to Tableau and Connecting to Datasets
    - Lesson 2: Basic Dashboard Design and Layout
    - Lesson 3: Creating Line, Bar, and Area Charts in Tableau
    - Lesson 4: Working with Calculated Fields and Aggregations
    - Lesson 5: Grouping Data and Using the GROUP BY Function
    - Lesson 6: Filtering Data using Context Filters and Parameters
    - Lesson 7: Creating Parameter-Driven Dashboards
    - Lesson 8: Building Interactive Maps with Tableau
    - Lesson 9: Connecting to Real-Time Streaming Data in Tableau
    - Lesson 10: Designing and Sharing Effective Business Intelligence Reports
